changes: Created and audit-hardened four Lattice baseline execution-plan documents for Engineering, Loop Engineering/UDM, Production Safety, and Capability Claim layers; fixed multi-host, soak, handoff, metric, and claim-boundary correctness gaps found by Claude/Codex review.
usage: Open Lattice-Engineering-baseline.md, Lattice-Loop-Engineering-baseline.md, Lattice-Production-Safety-baseline.md, and Lattice-Capability-Claim-baseline.md from the repository root to use them as the execution plan for baseline layers 2-5.
expectedOutcome: Four executable baseline documents exist, independent Claude/Codex host review reports no real correctness blockers, and Lattice validation covers all verification intents.
actualTranscript: koala validate --story=B-a10d --json returned status=pass, allPass=true, npm test/test:e2e ALL PASS, and Verification intent coverage 12/12 covered. Final Claude/Codex review artifacts all returned PASS with no findings.
outcomeDiff: No difference: expected documents, review pass, and validation coverage were observed after resolving the first audit findings.
limitations: The documents are execution plans for future baseline implementation; they do not by themselves implement the baseline runner or claim enforcement runtime.
pitfalls: Initial review found real correctness gaps rather than style issues. checklist_update replaced evidence for an item, so missing intents had to be restored with verification_evidence_batch_add. transcript-diff was first written outside the story worktree and then moved into the correct worktree path.
